integrity: Exact integer orbit-cell boundary matrices were independently built with two simplex orientations; Smith forms and chain identities were replayed from standalone code. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy assertion is only for the quotient by the specified 55-element affine group; the two subgroup quotients are classified in integral homology, not homotopy. Original nonequivariant Moore decomposition is established in prior work.
title: A Moore-space affine quotient of the Paley-11 directed flag complex
